# Nymrel Swarm Studio

Nymrel Swarm Studio is a private, static, fixture-driven React reference interface maintained by Nymrel.

## Verified repository facts

- Source: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-studio
- License: MIT
- Stack: React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 7, Vitest 4, Oxlint, npm 11
- Output: static files in `dist`
- Data: bundled synthetic fixtures only
- Persistence: none
- Application network requests: none
- External agents, repositories, providers, telemetry, files, commands, sandboxes, deployments, billing, customers, and revenue: not connected

## Interface scope

The interface demonstrates worker rosters, decision and protected-action cards, sample diffs, sample campaign progress, an illustrative routing-cost formula, and locally computed SHA-256/Merkle values. Interactions change browser memory only.

Displayed decisions are not enforcement. Displayed hashes are not provenance, authenticity, immutability, or an external audit. Displayed cost values are not provider pricing, usage, savings, or invoices. The project does not claim conformance with an external agent-to-UI protocol.

Use README.md and SECURITY.md as the human-readable source of truth. A build, release, or repository state does not prove a public deployment.
